'''Mikks''' was a [[Gangster/Legends|thug]] who worked for the [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]] of<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] on the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> Mikks and other thugs under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Dors Stelikag]], one of Esva's agents, discovered the [[Death/Legends|dead]] corpse of one of their thug colleagues, [[Kofter]]. After hiding the corpse in the trunk of their [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], Stelikag and Mikks traveled to a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] where Esva's [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] were holding the [[Bidor Ferrouz's family|family]] of Candoras's [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]], hostage.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mikks appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
